subtitle.zh: 基于 SenseNova/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT 的本地文生图（原生统一多模态、官方 11 个训练分辨率、最高原生 4K）：离线跑在本机一张 24G 显卡上，靠分层卸载把 32.66GB 权重装下。
subtitle.en: Local text-to-image with SenseNova/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT (native unified multimodal, 11 trained resolution buckets, up to native 4K), running offline on one 24GB GPU via layer offloading of the 32.66GB weights.

notes.zh: 本地 HTTP 服务由 MTNode 负责启停，端口 8774，接口 /health /generate /progress /cancel /shutdown；产物 PNG（可带 .think.txt 与 settings.json）落调用方给的 outputDir。权重约 32.66GB（ModelScope 优先下载），bf16 装不进 24G 显存，默认走 fast 分层卸载。
notes.en: MTNode starts/stops the local HTTP service on port 8774: /health /generate /progress /cancel /shutdown. The PNG (plus optional .think.txt and settings.json) is written into the caller-provided outputDir. Weights are ~32.66GB (ModelScope first) and do not fit 24GB VRAM in bf16, so fast layer offloading is the default.
